content: The participation rate for the FY26 Engagement Survey was **86%**.

messages.content:
Use the following context to answer the question.

Context:
[Engagement Surveys and Employer Awards > Surveys Overview > FY26 Engagement Survey Results]
Our FY26 Annual Engagement Survey ran from 2025-06-09 to 2025-06-30. The survey was open to team members hired before 2025-05-31.

- We reached 86% participation, which is 3% higher than the FY25 Engagement Survey.
- Overall engagement score of 75% favourable, 16% neutral and 9% unfavourable.
- We scored 3% lower than we did in the FY25 Engagement Survey overall, and 4% higher than our New Tech 1000+ peer group (January 2025 benchmark), which consists of fast-growing tech companies with 1000+ total team members.
- GitLab remains in a solid position from an overall engagement score perspective with several key opportunities highlighted in the detailed results section.

Below you will find a summary of our overall results, as well as key insights and opportunities. A huge thanks to everyone who completed the survey and made their voices heard. Your feedback helps us to continually improve the experience of working at GitLab.

[Engagement Surveys and Employer Awards > Surveys Overview > FY26-Q4 Pulse Survey > Overview]
The FY26-Q4 Pulse Survey is our first pulse survey, designed to provide a focused check-in on key sentiment areas from the annual survey and gather feedback following the All-Company assembly. This lighter-weight survey helps us track progress on our action plans and understand team member reactions to important business communications without waiting another 6+ months for the next annual survey.

[Engagement Surveys and Employer Awards > Surveys Overview > FY'23 Q2 Pulse Engagement Survey Results > FY'22 Pulse Engagement Survey > FY'22 Pulse Engagement Survey Questions]
The FY'22 Pulse Engagement Survey included 19 rating questions and 3 open ended text questions. A complete list of questions can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i25j1t55NK48bkT2MJh-05pSOcKKU3QMrU5D4wknS5w/edit#).
